justification: ISO 5259-3 §6.3.2 directly requires rules and processes to achieve data quality, DQM implementation, integration into management processes, and communication of policies (sub-items a-h). This completely satisfies Art 10(2) data governance and management practices.

legalFocus: Governance practices appropriate for intended purpose
justification: ISO 5259-3 §7.3.1.1(b) directly requires documenting scope, purpose and intended use. This completely satisfies the 'appropriate for intended purpose' element of Art 10(2).

legalFocus: Governance shall concern data enrichment and augmentation
justification: ISO 5259-3 §7.3.6.1 directly requires specifying data augmentation processes (covering enrichment and aggregation), completely satisfying Art 10(2)(c)'s enrichment/aggregation sub-element.

legalFocus: Datasets shall be relevant for intended purpose
justification: ISO 5259-3 §7.3.1.1(b) requires specifying scope, purpose and intended use, directly ensuring relevance. This completely satisfies Art 10(3)'s relevance requirement.
ISO 5259-3 §7.3.2.3 directly requires maintaining representativeness with respect to the target population for each subset. This completely satisfies Art 10(3)'s representativeness requirement.

legalFocus: Datasets shall be free of errors and complete
justification: ISO 5259-3 §7.3.5.2(a)-(c) requires measures for missing data (completeness), duplication and outliers (error-freeness). This completely satisfies Art 10(3)'s error-free and completeness requirements.
